turns.text: If we cut Kitchen prices 10%, how much extra volume do we need to keep gross profit the same?

csvChecks.ask: breakeven.csv with columns sku,pct,units,gp_change_gbp: one row per Kitchen SKU sold in 2025; pct the % change in volume that keeps gross profit the same, in percent (so -11.8 means an 11.8% fall) (positive is growth you need, negative a fall you can absorb), units the same in units, gp_change_gbp the gross-profit change at 2025 volumes; leave pct and units blank where breakeven doesn't apply
